query: Texas measles cases 2025 DSHS site:dshs.texas.gov OR site:gov
query_rationale: Targets the Texas Department of State Health Services (DSHS) directly — the primary subnational authority for Texas measles surveillance. Expected to return DSHS measles dashboard, press releases, and situation updates with confirmed/probable case counts, death counts, and county-level breakdowns.

expected_trust_signal: Official .gov domain; DSHS authorship; dated situation reports or dashboards
